title: Metagraphed Entity Label
description: Community-contributable label ("nametag") for a known ss58 address -- one file per address, same single-file-per-entity shape as registry/providers/<slug>.json. Every claim needs an independent source_urls proof, matching subnet surfaces' own convention; the public-safety scan applies identically. See docs/nametag-evidence-bar.md for what counts as proof.

ss58.description: The labeled address. Must match this file's own name (registry/entities/<ss58>.json).

name.description: Human-readable entity name, e.g. "Binance" or "Rayon Labs".

category.description: What kind of entity this address belongs to. `operator` and `other` predate #8372's widening and are retained so existing labels stay valid; prefer the more specific categories (`infra` over `operator`, or the exact fit over `other`) for new entries.

url.description: The entity's own canonical homepage, for linking the rendered nametag. Distinct from source_urls, which prove the ADDRESS belongs to the entity -- a homepage alone is not proof of address ownership.

source_urls.description: Independent proof this address belongs to the named entity (e.g. an official announcement, a block explorer's own tag, the entity's own published address list). A claim with no proof is not accepted.

review.description: Human-governance axis ONLY, same shape and meaning as a subnet surface's own `review` block -- a label enters as "community-submitted"; a maintainer promotes it to "maintainer-reviewed" or marks it "rejected".
